identity: GRS III square office/laboratory wing and rounded stair tower, Boltzmannstraße 14
referencePeriod: 1994–1996 project; historical photographs do not establish every current detail
referenceUse: Visual reference only; copyrighted photos/plans are not embedded or redistributed.
observations: Square main wing with eight perimeter columns at corners and wall centres; attached rounded stair tower connects to GRS II. The survey square is approximately 23.95 m on each side, south of the tower; the architect plan matches after rotation.
Three visible glazing levels including a partly exposed lower level, pale projecting floor edges, upper diagonal braces and external horizontal blinds appear in the exterior photograph.

The project description specifies square concrete columns set diagonally, a raised lower level lit by surrounding slopes, and an upper glazed steel structure. The section depicts a central raised roof.
Courtyard photograph shows a pale rounded tower with a low entrance and adjacent glazing.
preservation: All 30 surveyed wall faces and 50 orthophoto roof triangles retained, including the raised central roof (Y=72.30–75.25). No terrain change or interiors.
inferences: Window bands, bay widths, blind drops, frames and brace positions are estimated from the historical photos within the survey envelope.
Colours and glazing reflections are approximate; photographs are monochrome.
Less-visible elevations extrapolate the observed modular facade. The tower rear remains primarily opaque because exact current openings are not established.
